author: WackaFlackaFlame
body:
Hello, my in game name is WackaFlackaFlame (changed from old name ChampionCreeper)

It has been three months since my ban back in January and hopefully that is a significant amount of time of being banned. I really enjoyed playing on Avicus and really want to come back.

I know I have a lot of infractions but I have learned to keep my mouth shut in the chat unless I have something nice or positive to say. I promise if I get unbanned that this kind of incident will never happen again. 

Getting banned has taught me a valuable lesson about kindness and good sportsmanship towards all other players on the Avicus Network. Hopefully you can find it in your heart to unban me so I can play on one of my favorite minecraft servers.

Thank you for reading this and hopefully I can get unbanned :)

Thanks Again,
WackaFlackaFlame
